objective: server/services/russell/search.ts like() (~L112) backslash-escapes \, % and _ but none of the six LIKE ? statements says ESCAPE '\', and SQLite has no default escape character, so on SQLite searching 'county_fees' or '10%' finds nothing even when present (Postgres defaults to backslash). Fix: append ESCAPE '\' to every LIKE ? in search.ts; valid on both dialects. tests/step12bProduct.test.ts search cases use plain words and must keep passing. The new test should run against the configured test database.
expectedOutcome: A search for text containing % or _ finds it on both backends.

acceptanceConditions.statement: underscore and percent searches match on SQLite, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
